name: Cubing on Par B 2023

venue.name: [University Golf Club, UBC](https://universitygolf.com)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the Salons room next to the Westward Ho!

information: Welcome to Cubing on Par 2023! Please note that this is part of a series, with an A and B competition happening on Saturday on Sunday. This competition (B) is happening on **Sunday, April 23rd**. See the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingonParB2023#26265-series-competitions) tab for more information. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday. Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.
